issue.description:
AGENTS.md states 'Never claim compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite' and names research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md as the definition of NEEDLE compatibility. Existing conformance lanes are all feature-specific (claim epochs BR-T27, redaction BR-T18, attempt-resolution); no suite tests the CLI against the NEEDLE contract itself, so the documented rule has no enforcement path for the project's one named compatibility profile. Work: convert the contract spec into executable conformance cases run in CI (iad-ci bead-rs-ci), gate compatibility claims and release beads on a green run, and record the evidence on the release bead.
